guides.title: System Workflow — Master Document
guides.subtitle: How DBL Group’s manpower requisition, recruitment and onboarding system works — end to end, role by role.
guides.audience: DBL Group management, the CHRO and HR leadership, and everyone who sets up, runs or supports the hiring process.

guides.title: Requisition Raiser
guides.subtitle: How to raise a manpower requisition and see it through job analysis and approval.
guides.audience: Department and division heads, and anyone nominated to raise manpower requisitions for a unit or factory.

guides.title: Factory HR
guides.subtitle: Job analysis for your unit’s requisitions, CVs sent in to the recruiter, and the first interviews handed to you.
guides.audience: HR officers at each unit or factory who hold the Factory HR role.

guides.title: Requisition Approver
guides.subtitle: How to review and sign off manpower requisitions when you are named in an approval chain.
guides.audience: Unit approvers, SBU Heads, factory and division heads — anyone named as a level in a raiser’s approval chain.

guides.title: Head of Talent Acquisition
guides.subtitle: Final approval of every requisition, launching recruitment, Hiring Approval Sheets, medical requests and the settings that drive the workflow.
guides.audience: Head of Talent Acquisition and the corporate talent-acquisition team holding this role.

guides.title: Chief Human Resources Officer
guides.subtitle: Escalated requisitions, Hiring Approval Sheets, signing letters, and oversight of the whole hiring process.
guides.audience: The CHRO, and anyone holding the CHRO role in the system.

guides.title: Board Member
guides.subtitle: Approving requisitions and Hiring Approval Sheets from an emailed link — no sign-in required.
guides.audience: Members of DBL Group’s board who are asked to approve requisitions or selected candidates.

guides.title: Corporate Recruiter
guides.subtitle: Running a requisition’s hiring from job posting to the new hire’s first day: candidates, tests, interviews, salary fixation and onboarding.
guides.audience: Corporate Recruiters assigned to requisitions by Head of Talent Acquisition.

guides.title: Factory HR Head
guides.subtitle: Approving the finalists your unit’s Factory HR puts through after a first interview, and sending CVs to the recruiter.
guides.audience: Heads of HR at units and factories who hold the Factory HR Head role.

guides.title: Interview Panelist & Interviewer
guides.subtitle: Scoring candidates and recommending an outcome — and running a first interview when candidates are handed to you.
guides.audience: Managers and staff who sit on interview panels, and colleagues asked to run a candidate’s first interview.

guides.title: Medical Officer & Central Medical Officer
guides.subtitle: Recording pre-employment medical examinations and confirming every finding before a candidate is cleared.
guides.audience: Examining Medical Officers and the Central Medical Officer.

guides.title: The Candidate Journey
guides.subtitle: What applicants and new hires see and do — from the careers page to their joining date.
guides.audience: HR teams who support applicants, and anyone who needs to understand the system from the candidate’s side.

guides.title: System Administrator & Super User
guides.subtitle: Access control, organisation set-up, integrations, monitoring and records — keeping the system running for everyone else.
guides.audience: The platform administrator account, Super Users and the IT Department, DBL Group.
